name: Tomosato Risa
source:
Risa is brash and loud. She lives by herself nearby, so she enjoys coming by to visit and save money on food. She is a classic tsundere who won't admit her feelings for Ryuichi. Risa is the younger sister of Kyouko, but is treated as a sister by protagonist. 

[From [url=https://www.jastusa.com/sweet-home]JAST USA[/url]]
